public_source_verification: Repository marked Public and all five exact commit raw URLs opened without credentials before calls. Original richer internal-context request was blocked by automatic review; only verified public-source facts submitted.

state.purpose: Evaluate optional Rust kernel boundaries for this public open-source repository. Only public source facts are supplied; no benchmark or host-feature result is assumed.

icu.facts: Values IcuParser and compiler analysis/examples.rs IcuParser plus UI messages.ts implement related bounded grammar. Values treats # outside plural as literal; compiler rejects it. Runtime uses Intl locale/plural/date and exact numeric guards. Sharing parsing may reduce semantic drift; unification must resolve profile differences first. No measured parser bottleneck. Alternatives: retain profiled parsers with shared cases; shared TS parse owner; agreed Rust parse/usage core with host formatting retained.

query.facts: orderSourceReadRecords decodes typed keys then sorts after host authority/projection. Ordering and singleton decode errors observable. Money compare may throw. String/id UTF16 order and row identity matter. Page candidates cap1000, storage may scan more. Two-valued policy differs from SQL three-valued predicate behavior. Alternatives: retain/optimize TS prepared keys; Rust admitted total-order key batch to permutation; broader kernel with host callbacks. No latency/copy-cost evidence. Keep authority and source evaluation ordering intact.

files.facts: Synchronous detectContentType/checkContent uses small PDF/PNG/JPEG magic, otherwise nonempty NUL-free fatal TextDecoder UTF8. sha256Hex uses noble JS SHA256, consumed in completion/finalize/read/retention. Host authority/counts precede checks; failed content causes cleanup. Alternatives: current TS plus host native decoding; whole immutable byte-buffer Rust detection/digest kernel; async WebCrypto would require sync caller changes. No CPU measurements. Signature checks alone tiny; potential benefit only whole buffers.

diff.facts: textHunks/myersDiff used by generation runDiff. Strict UTF8 round trip, LF splitting, Myers tie choices, n*m>4000000 fallback delete/insert;50 hunks/500 output lines enforced after full diff. Trace retained below fallback. Alternatives: retain bounded TS; improve memory algorithm TS; Rust pure bytes-to-hunks leaf with exact output compatibility and local delivery. No measured bottleneck; memory concern is static inference, not observed failure. Process/lease/journal remain host functions.

judgment.facts: staticResult exactJson requires JSON.parse reviver context.source for numbers; throws if unavailable. wireDecimal guards exponent/scale, exact decimal units and tolerance, int64 usage, source question order, winner/distribution and weighted score checks. Legacy Number mapper separate. No established supported-host failure. Alternatives: keep host JSON parser; JS raw numeric lexeme reader; Rust raw-response to canonical static-result kernel with exact Values arithmetic. Must preserve duplicate-last-wins, strings/surrogates, invalid-to-null behavior and source ordering. HTTP/provider binding remains host.

criteria.propose_port: Source evidence supports proposing a finite Rust implementation boundary now, subject to compatibility and delivery validation; further comparison need not precede the ownership proposal.
criteria.evaluate_first: A finite contract/consumer or performance comparison is worthwhile before choosing Rust ownership; current implementation remains until that decision.
criteria.retain_now: Keep current language and ownership; no new comparison is justified until a concrete consumer need or measured problem appears.
